description: Land Acquisition - Harasgala - Kekirihena & other Villages, D/S Division Maha Oya - Ampara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain lands are needed for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land plots with their boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Janaka Bandara Thennakoon), the core content is about land matters rather than government personnel or structural changes, making it a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
